title: CSV Wire
discovery: Portal welcome → File Format Guides (BAI2) → SWIFT MT103 → MT940 → MT942 → ISO PAIN.001 US Fedwire → ISO PAIN.001 SWIFT → CSV Wire; actual links followed, no guessed slug.
revision: Portal rendering stated Updated 20 days ago; no semantic version or exact update timestamp verified. Local candidate r1 is pinned to this functional extraction, not a claimed upstream version.
structure: One payment per row; comma-separated; all fields must be wrapped in double quotes. Encoding, headers, line endings and quote escaping are not specified.

international.name: Effective Date
international.validation: USD = not to exceed 30 days in the future. CAD = today's date + 1 business day. All other currencies = today's date + 2 business days

international.name: Credit Amount
international.validation: If a Credit Amount is included, the Debit Amount must still also be included. However, the Credit Amount indicated will be used to calculate the actual Debit Amount based on the exchange rate of the Credit Currency regardless of the Debit Amount submitted in the file. Must have decimal point and numbers only and have less than 18 significant figures

ambiguities: Samples leave empty fields unquoted, contrary to the all-fields-quoted rule.
Both example debit accounts contain a nonnumeric placeholder despite the required 11-digit account.
International intermediary SWIFT/BIC is described as 13 characters, unlike the 11-character primary BIC.
International account format S34 is not defined in the format key.
No bank time zone, business-day holiday calendar, character encoding or upstream semantic version is supplied.
Significant figures, positivity, optional intermediary pairing, header handling, row terminators and escaping need disclosed candidate decisions.
